Business problems

  • Combining market days, event times, and publication dates can inadvertently use information that was not yet available.
  • Backtest outcomes vary with fees, liquidity assumptions, data versions, and reference strategies.
  • Research needs traceable sources and assumptions so reviewers can rerun and challenge it.

Engineering capabilities

  • Model provenance, as-of times, revisions, and missingness.
  • Define train, validation, and test periods and compare costs, constraints, and reference strategies.
  • Record backtest configuration, results, failure scenarios, and reproducible outputs.

Frequently asked questions

Can you review an existing backtest?

Yes. We start with the data and assumptions closest to deployment, pin dates, imputation, and cost estimates, then design the comparison.

What does this service deliver?

The deliverables are data systems, models, evaluation, and review workflows. Results are presented within their historical or research conditions.
